linked_prs.title: feat: add gpt-5-chat-latest model support
linked_prs.body:
## Summary
Added support for the `gpt-5-chat-latest` model to the OpenAI LLM integration as requested in issue #19663.

## Changes
- Added `gpt-5-chat-latest` to `O1_MODELS` dictionary with 400,000 token context window
- Added comprehensive unit test to validate model integration
- Model supports chat functionality, function calling, and proper context size validation

## Motivation
The `gpt-5-chat-latest` model is officially available in OpenAI's API but was missing from LlamaIndex's supported models list, preventing users from utilizing this model.

Fixes #19663
